# symbo

> \[!WARNING\]  
> This package is in early development and not yet ready for use

symbo takes two molecular structures and assesses (based on their
symmetry properties) the geometric feasability of forming different
higher-order structures (e.g. tetrahedral / edge-capped cube /
face-capped cube / etc.)

![](reference/figures/input_structures.png)

![](reference/figures/optimised.png)

## Getting Started

Please see the
[manual](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/articles/manual.html).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`OptimisationInputs()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/OptimisationInputs.md)
  : Optimisation Inputs
- [`OptimisationResult()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/OptimisationResult.md)
  : Optimisation result for two aligned molecules
- [`OptimisationResultBasic()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/OptimisationResultBasic.md)
  : Basic optimisation result
- [`OptimisationResultCollection()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/OptimisationResultCollection.md)
  : Collection of optimisation results
- [`Vec3()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/Vec3.md) : A
  three-dimensional numeric vector
- [`axes_to_shapeclass_reference()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/axes_to_shapeclass_reference.md)
  : Mapping Proper Rotation Axes to ShapeClasses
- [`create_summary_report()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/create_summary_report.md)
  : Create a report summarising results of screen
- [`extract_optimisation_inputs()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/extract_optimisation_inputs.md)
  : Extract optimisation inputs
- [`generate_loss_function()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/generate_loss_function.md)
  : Generate Optimisation functoin
- [`get_assessable_shapeclasses()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/get_assessable_shapeclasses.md)
  : Get assessable polyhedral geometries from symmetry axis orders
- [`get_assessable_shapeclasses_from_molecules()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/get_assessable_shapeclasses_from_molecules.md)
  : Get assessable shapeclasses from molecule objects
- [`list_all_shapeclasses()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/list_all_shapeclasses.md)
  : List all valid shapeclasses
- [`optimise_L_BFGS_B()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/optimise_L_BFGS_B.md)
  : Minimise a loss function by L_BFGS_B
- [`optimise_surface_annealing()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/optimise_surface_annealing.md)
  : Minimise a loss function by surface annealing
- [`screen_molecules()`](https://selkamand.github.io/symbo/reference/screen_molecules.md)
  : Screen molecules for valid Shape classes
